verdict.rationale: White-label embedded payroll is a fair question for a payroll product, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows ADP API Central, which offers integration APIs for real-time HR data sharing with ADP. It does not show any partner API that lets a developer embed white-labeled RUN payroll in their own product. Third-party integrations like Zenefits sitting on top of ADP are not ADP-provided white-label embedding.

support.subject: As a developer, I can embed white-label payroll into my own product through a partner API
